options: Thank you. And where’s the elevator?
exercises.why: «Спасибо. А где лифт?» — Thank you. And where’s the elevator? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain), Вариант диалога 2.

options: Fine. And how long will you be staying?
No, a double. I’m going with my husband.
What kind of room do you need? A single?
exercises.why: «Девушка, номер 503 в какую сторону?» — Miss, which way is room 503? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain), Диалог 3.

options: You’re welcome. If you need anything, just ask me.
exercises.why: «Направо? Спасибо.» — To the right? Thank you. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain), Диалог 3.
exercises.context: Диалог 3 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain)

exercises.ru: Девушка, извините. Вы работаете на этом этаже?
options: Miss, excuse me. Do you work on this floor?
What kind of room do you need? A single?
Here’s the form and our passports.
exercises.why: «Девушка, извините. Вы работаете на этом этаже?» — Miss, excuse me. Do you work on this floor? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain), Диалог 4.
